intent: A pressure quiz: three dive depths drop as bars so the sperm whale and the seal fall short, a whale sticker rises out of the dark basin off California where the record was logged, a flash marks the crush of 300 atmospheres, and a pin lands on Cape Hatteras where one animal held its breath for three hours and forty-two minutes.
pacing_profile: question read verbatim, three options, 3-s beat, reveal with the number, story beats shaped per episode (brief.md), punchline + short follow
pause_policy: Pause only at the marked ellipses; the beat is real silence (ticks come from quizscore.py).
title: Which mammal dives the DEEPEST?

lines.direction: the question, cold — curiosity comes from the map moving under it
quick, each option its own beat
lines.text: Sperm whale, Elephant seal, or Beaked whale?
Cuvier's beaked whale. Off California, a tagged whale reached 2,992 metres, the deepest dive ever recorded for a mammal.

lines.direction: ease back over the California Bight; three depths drop as bars on 'sperm' with the beaked whale's bar reaching far below the others; a whale sticker on 'sperm', a seal sticker on 'elephant'; the coast pulses on 'short'
lines.text: A sperm whale manages about 2,250 metres; an elephant seal just under 2,400. Both fall short.

lines.direction: tighten on the basin south of the Channel Islands; on 'lungs' the dark basin outline appears and a whale sticker rises out of it with the record tag; a lungs sticker on 'lungs', a heart on 'heart'; a white flash on 'pressure' with the 300 atmospheres tag as the coast pulses
lines.text: Its lungs collapse on purpose, its heart slows, and its muscles store the oxygen under 300 times surface pressure.

lines.direction: glide across the continent to the Carolina coast; the Cape Hatteras pin on 'Hatteras'; a stopwatch sticker and the 3 h 42 min card on 'hours'; a trophy sticker on 'longest' as the coast pulses; both pins leave at the end
lines.text: Off Cape Hatteras, one stayed under for 3 hours and 42 minutes, the longest dive ever recorded for a mammal.

lines.direction: punchline, then a short follow — the outro visual asks
lines.text: Three hours, one breath. Follow us.
